source.title: 诊断学（第10版）
source.section: 第五篇 辅助检查 第一章 心电图 第三节

textbook_summary: Right-atrial findings: total P duration is not prolonged; tall P waves in II/III/aVF are >= 0.25 mV, upright P in V1 is >= 0.15 mV, and the P axis is > 75 degrees.
Biatrial findings: P duration is >= 120 ms with amplitude >= 0.25 mV, and V1 has a large biphasic P wave.
scope: Nonspecific right-atrial and biatrial abnormal P-wave teaching morphologies, not an anatomical atrial model or diagnostic classifier.

right.shape: Existing smooth P kernel with one tall peak, total duration 100 ms, and no double-peak notch.

notes: Amplitudes and durations are project-authored choices, not exact textbook case samples. Limb coefficients sum to zero; integer scaling may leave Q32 quantization residue, while electrode projection remains exact. PR and QRS/ST/T/u are not shifted.

verification: Checks projected amplitudes, support, peak shape and the fixed right-atrial P axis at 250 Hz, Einthoven identities, unchanged ventricular samples, recovery bytes, native rendering and atomic switching.
limitations: Continuous independent P/QRS/T axes are not implemented.
Not all variants of each morphology are included.
Actual right/left atrial contributions and secondary hemodynamics are not modeled.
Manual verification on Windows hardware is deferred to a combined session.
